statement: Hooks come only from REFramework Lua + plugin DLL; no memory patching
DD2 patches rotate IL2CPP layouts; typed access needs version guards
REFramework Lua runs on render thread; I/O goes off-thread via native plugin
Never read, write, or stat DD2 save files
Never ship Capcom assets (textures, meshes, scripts, audio, decompiled code)
Never mutate DD2 entities, pawns, flags, inventory, world state
Do not reverse-engineer DD2's pawn network; read state via IL2CPP only
One person. Every architectural decision is priced in weekends
Assume Tailscale/ZeroTier tailnet or LAN. NAT traversal not our problem
No DBs, no disk state, no migrations. In-memory ring buffers only
Zero distribution is an acceptable floor
Mod never mutates DD2 state; overlay draws only
Mod has no read or write access to DD2 save files
All hooks go through REFramework; no external loaders

claim: REFramework exposes three layers: (1) Lua sdk.* (find_type_definition, get_managed_singleton, get_primary_camera, hook, call_object_func) + draw.* (world_to_screen, world_text, sphere, capsule) safe in re.on_frame; (2) callbacks re.on_frame (game thread), re.on_draw_ui, re.on_pre_application_entry("BeginRendering"|"EndRendering"|"UpdateBehavior"), re.on_pre_gui_draw_element (render thread); (3) plugin C ABI via reframework_plugin_initialize(REFrameworkPluginInitializeParam*) giving renderer_data (D3D device/swapchain/queue), on_present (render thread, post-swap), lock_lua/unlock_lua, on_device_reset, on_imgui_frame. No on_frame at C ABI. UDP thread must never touch sdk.* or managed objects — push bytes to lock-free queue, drain from re.on_frame.
evidence: REFramework book Lua reference + include/reframework/API.h + examples/example_plugin

claim: DD2 community-confirmed IL2CPP read path for local player + camera: sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):get_ManualPlayer():get_GameObject():get_Transform():get_Position()/get_Rotation(); sdk.get_primary_camera() returns via.Camera used implicitly by draw.world_to_screen. RE Engine matrices are column-major, LH, Y-up. Stable across 2.01→Jan 2026 when resolved by NAME via find_type_definition; offsets and TDB indices are NOT stable. Managed-object handles are not GC-pinned — re-resolve ManualPlayer each frame or re-hook on app.CharacterManager.requestSetUpPlayer.
evidence: Working DD2 Lua precedent in xyzkljl1/MyDD2Mod DamageNumber.lua, gibbed/DD2-REFramework-Scripts, PatukiR/DD2 WorldMultiplier.lua

claim: frogma_plugin.dll cross-compiles cleanly from Linux via cargo-xwin to x86_64-pc-windows-msvc. Output is a 186880-byte PE32+ x86-64 DLL at target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/frogma_plugin.dll. All 6 C ABI exports present and unmangled: reframework_plugin_required_version, reframework_plugin_initialize, frogma_push_local_state, frogma_peer_count, frogma_peer_view, frogma_local_peer_id. No apt lld/clang install needed — cargo-xwin bundles clang-cl and drives rustc's built-in lld-link. MSVC CRT/WinSDK headers auto-fetched on first build (~600MB cached in ~/.cache/cargo-xwin/). XWIN_ACCEPT_LICENSE=1 suppresses the EULA prompt.
evidence: Local build: XWIN_ACCEPT_LICENSE=1 cargo xwin build --release -p frogma-plugin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; exports verified via strings|grep; file(1) confirms PE32+ x86-64

claim: DD2 IL2CPP player-position path confirmed still-works post-Jan-2026 patch via xyzkljl1/MyDD2Mod commits Feb 19-Mar 14 2026. Preferred 3-tier resolve chain from MyDD2Mod samplePlayerPosition(): (1) CharacterManager.<ManualPlayer>k__BackingField -> GameObject:get_Transform:get_UniversalPosition (double precision, DD2's actual world-space position), (2) fallback cm:get_ManualPlayer() -> same transform chain, (3) fallback mp:call('get_LastGroundPosition') for teleport/loading frames. ManualPlayer goes nil during title screen, loading, cutscenes, fast-travel, pawn/Arisen-swap — community pattern is re-resolve every frame + cache last-good, NOT hook requestSetUpPlayer. gibbed/DD2-REFramework-Scripts is stale (last updated April 2024).
evidence: https://github.com/xyzkljl1/MyDD2Mod samplePlayerPosition() helper + commit log Feb-Mar 2026

claim: DD2's get_UniversalPosition returns double-precision (f64) world position, distinct from get_Position which returns f32 Vector4f. DD2's open world is large enough that f32 loses precision far from origin. Our wire format (frogma-wire Snapshot.pos: [f32;3]) downcasts at sample time — acceptable for v0.1 ghost-overlay proximity since we only render peers close enough to be visible, but becomes a precision debt if we ever render distant peers or interpolate across warps. v0.2 consideration: widen snapshot pos to [f64;3] (+12 bytes per packet, still <60 bytes total).
evidence: MyDD2Mod samplePlayerPosition() uses get_UniversalPosition specifically over get_Position; RE Engine community docs note DD2 world-space scale

claim: No current DD2 REFramework mod rolls its own view*proj*world_pos projection math — every ghost/overlay-drawing DD2 script found uses draw.world_to_screen from cursey.github.io/reframework-book/api/draw.html. RE Engine matrices are confirmed column-major, LH, Y-up (GLM convention, consistent with REFramework's RETransform using glm::mat4), but since the canonical projection helper works and returns nil on off-screen for free culling, there's no documented reason to reinvent it.
evidence: Search of gibbed, MyDD2Mod, PatukiR, kagenocookie DD2 repos for world_to_screen usage patterns

claim: Lua 5.1 and LuaJIT 2.1 have INCOMPATIBLE internal lua_State struct layouts despite sharing the same C API function signatures. Statically linking Lua 5.1 C API (lua_pushcclosure, lua_setfield, lua_tonumber etc.) and calling them on a LuaJIT-created lua_State* causes memory corruption and crashes. REFramework reported: 'Exception occurred in on_lua_state_created callback'. This rules out the 'vendor a compatible Lua C API lib' approach for plugin→Lua function registration.
evidence: Direct test: vendored lua-src-550.0.0 Lua 5.1.5 compiled via zig cc to x86_64-windows-msvc, linked into frogma_plugin.dll, called lua_pushcclosure on REFramework's LuaJIT state → instant crash. REFramework log: [APIProxy] Exception occurred in on_lua_state_created callback.

claim: File-based IPC between frogma_plugin.dll and frogma.lua works end-to-end in DD2. Plugin writes reframework/frogma_peers.txt (atomic rename, 50ms poll), Lua writes reframework/frogma_local.txt (per-frame via io.open). Confirmed: real DD2 world coordinates flowing through the pipe: self=(-1363.14,109.18,414.93) yaw=-2.60, which is a valid in-world position from app.CharacterManager → ManualPlayer → Transform → get_UniversalPosition (f64 downcast to f32). Position correctly goes (stale) during menu transitions. Q-0002 partially answered (player position reads work), Q-0004 fully answered (plugin loads, initializes, peer threads survive).
evidence: re2_framework_log.txt 2026-04-06 lines 56596-57342; frogma_local.txt + frogma_peers.txt confirmed written on disk

claim: DD2 Title Update 3.2 (2026-09-01, engine/perf rework, 6 skill slots, 3 save slots) broke REFramework outright; praydog landed 'Initial fix for DD2' 2026-09-02 and DD2 follow-ups through nightly 01424 (2026-09-16). Exit hang on TU 3.2 still open (issue #1834). TU 3.2 removed callable methods that many Lua mods used, so Ridog8's Method Library addon became a common dependency. REFramework plugin API is 1.15.0 (bumped 2025-04-21); PluginLoader only rejects plugins whose required minor is NEWER than the host, so frogma_plugin's 1.10 pin still loads on current nightlies. Dark Arisen expansion ships 2026-10-09; expect another break and IL2CPP reshuffle right after.
evidence: REFramework commit log 2026-09-02..09-16, REFramework-nightly release list, src/mods/PluginLoader.cpp version check, include/reframework/API.h, Nexus TU 3.2 mod pages requiring Method Library

claim: DD2gether (But-Frog, Nexus mod 1479, github But-Frog/dd2-together-release) is a full 4-player network co-op mod for DD2: each player controls their own Arisen with enemies, NPCs, combat and environment synced over Steam lobbies.
